documented_canonical_pin.source: docs/pdfium-binary-provisioning.md; the project's documented pinned binary from pypdfium2 5.8.0 wheel

pin_gap_warning: The 70-source corpus was ingested against libpdfium-nojs (Arch packaging), not the documented canonical pin pdfium 149.0.7825.0. Chunk text bytes and chunk_hash values are tied to this runtime. Re-ingest on a different host requires either (a) installing the same libpdfium-nojs build, OR (b) a coordinated switch to the documented canonical pin followed by a full 70-source re-ingest that regenerates chunk_hash values. Until either action is taken, `kb verify` will detect chunk_hash divergence on any host with a different libpdfium binary.
re_ingest_blockers: library_sha256_mismatch: any host with a different libpdfium.so SHA-256 cannot reproduce the existing 57603 chunk_hash values
schema_version_change: future cacg-core schema bumps require a full re-ingest
